capabilities: experimental terminal veto and prefix tripwire
requires_before_any_adoption: Separate explicit owner approval for one host and exact source revision
Independent review of candidate and verifier revisions
Verify actual installed Hermes version and local tool/configuration compatibility
Verify consent, registration, invocation and effects in the real caller path
Scope expected repository, revision and effects; this experiment only checks origin metadata
Review known escapes; do not rely on this tripwire as a security boundary
rollback: No operator installation exists. Remove the experiment directory to remove its local sandbox, or revert the unmerged branch. A future separately reviewed installation must supply its own config rollback.
